decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence. It also utilizes cards like Atraxa and Fallaji Archaeologist to generate value and control the board. The deck combines instant reanimation with combo potential to put pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation and Thoughseize to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and disrupting their game plan. By using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's aggression and establish board control. Cards like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide threats that can close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining a strong control over the game while applying pressure with efficient threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies with a mix of burn spells and land destruction to overwhelm opponents quickly. It aims to utilize multiple colors for flexibility and power, while also incorporating Leyline cards for added synergy and protection. The versatile creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco provide strong threats, while cards like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt offer additional reach and removal. The deck tries to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply early pressure on the opponent. Utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to continuously chip away at the opponent's life total while also controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Seasoned Pyromancer. With powerful finishing cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize, ultimately securing victory through a relentless onslaught of damage.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes powerful spells such as Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to help deal direct damage and control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support and protection for your creatures. Consign to Memory provides card advantage and flexibility, while cards like Stubborn Denial and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer disruption and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional reach and removal. The mana base includes fetch lands like Marsh Flats and Arid Mesa to ensure consistent mana fixing. Static Prison and Thraben Charm provide additional control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and disruption.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to maximize their value. By repeatedly blinking creatures like Flickerwisp and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck can disrupt opponents' strategies and generate continuous advantage. Cards like Ephemerate and Fatal Push provide control elements to deal with threats, while Thoughtseize enables targeted disruption. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence through efficient use of blink effects. It utilizes a combination of strong creatures and powerful utility lands to create a versatile and potent Aggro-Blink strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By employing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain card advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats. The deck's goal is to apply consistent pressure and end the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck aims to aggressively play creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing blink effects to exile key cards temporarily. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures, removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, as well as cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to flicker creatures for additional value. With a focus on tempo and disruption, the deck seeks to outpace the opponent while controlling the board with blink effects and removal spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and utilizing blink effects to temporarily remove threats and gain additional value from creature abilities. By combining powerful aggro creatures with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells to ensure that the opponent cannot stabilize easily. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive plays, while leveraging blink effects to outvalue the opponent.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Teferi, Time Raveler, while also removing threats with Prismatic Ending and Wrath of the Skies, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually win the game with powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck is designed to maintain board control and card advantage in order to win the game through value and tempo.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and using them to overpower the opponent with aggressive attacks. It utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage and synergize well with artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent's defenses and close out the game quickly with its efficient artifact creatures and powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emperor of Bones, then using Goryo's Vengeance or Fallaji Archaeologist to bring them back into play for a game-ending combo. Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces, while Ephemerate and Solitude provide additional ways to control the board. The variety of fetch lands and mana fixing ensure consistency in casting key spells, while cards like Tainted Indulgence and Atraxa, Grand Unifier offer additional utility and synergy with the deck's overall strategy.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Guide of Souls to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to buff up creatures and make them more threatening. The deck is designed to pressure the opponent early and maintain board control with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The combination of fast creatures and powerful buffs allows the deck to overwhelm opponents and win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Wrath of the Skies. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and control the game. The deck also includes creatures like Quantum Riddler and Solitude for additional control options. The mana base is set up to support the blue-white control strategy with utility lands like Minamo, School at Water's Edge and Flooded Strand to fix mana and find the right answers.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, and pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain momentum throughout the game by combining burn and creature damage with card draw and Scry effects from cards like Expressive Iteration and Preordain. It relies on a low curve and efficient plays to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.
